QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Loyalties 3
QuestInfo.0: The Prince of Whales thought the Stump's Eyeball was pretty. How long will #b#p1095003##k make you help with her ridiculous schemes?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1095003##k is fed up! This time, she wants you to get as many #r#t04000043#s#k as you can and pinch #b#p1092003##k with them. How many claws does it take to pinch a whale, anyway? Twenty?
QuestInfo.2: Today you learned an important lesson. According to whale customs, when you pinch someone with a claw, you're asking them to marry you. You almost proposed to #b#p1092003##k! Maybe you should stop listening to #b#p1095003##k...

0.0: He said...#r#t4033014#s#k are beautiful? How... Prince #b#p1092003##k is the strangest prince I've ever heard of. #b#p1090000##k definitely deserves better than that weirdo! \r\nI can't stand him...but how can I get rid of him? \r\n
0.1: Okay, I've got it this time! Get some #r#t04000043#s#k, and pinch Prince #b#p1092003##k with them! Those #r#t04000043#s#k really hurt, and when he starts crying, his reputation around here will be ruined. Mwa ha ha haa!

yes.0: Lorangs are all over #bFlorina Beach#k. 20 Lorang Claws should be more than enough to pinch the Prince. I guess you really only need one, but I want you to have lots of backups. Collect 20 #r#t04000043#s#k, and pinch Prince #p1092003# hard, okay?

no.0: Yeah, I know it's childish, but it's for a good cause! This is for #b#p1090000##k!

1.0: Yikes! Wha? You!\r\nYou know... I'm already in love with someone...\r\n

yes.0: Oh, you don't know what that Claw means? In whale culture, we use those claws to pinch those we wish to marry. I really thought... Oh, #h0#...you're so funny!

npc.0: Collect 20 #r#t04000043#s#k and pinch Prince #p1092003# with them. Make him cry!

item.0: Hello again! It's always a pleasure to see you. Did you have something to show me?
